# react-native-skia-chart

> GPU-accelerated, animated, fully typed charts for Expo / React Native, built on react-native-skia 3.8.0 and Reanimated 4.

- [Agent guide](https://baraa-rasheed.github.io/react-native-skia-chart/docs/agents): rules, component picker, prop patterns, recipes
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/baraa-rasheed/react-native-skia-chart/blob/main/AGENTS.md)
- [Type-checked recipes](https://github.com/baraa-rasheed/react-native-skia-chart/blob/main/example/recipes/agent-recipes.tsx)
- [Charts](https://baraa-rasheed.github.io/react-native-skia-chart/docs/charts)
- [API reference](https://baraa-rasheed.github.io/react-native-skia-chart/docs/api)
- [Gradients](https://baraa-rasheed.github.io/react-native-skia-chart/docs/gradients)
- [GPU effects](https://baraa-rasheed.github.io/react-native-skia-chart/docs/effects)

Key rules: import from 'react-native-skia-chart'; width/height are required pixel numbers; labels need a Skia `font`; `gradient` and `effects` are optional on every chart; requires a dev build.

- Interactivity: scrub (interactive, onScrub, scrubActivation), selection (selectable, selectedIndex, onSelect), and zoom (pinch, pan, double-tap). See /docs/interaction.
